marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Recent quarterly updates from major US tech firms indicate sustained double-digit increases in capital expenditure directed toward AI servers and data center expansion alongside steady enterprise cloud growth.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor suppliers and infrastructure enablers will maintain strong order visibility, though near-term margin compression may weigh on pure-play software providers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization timeline of consumer-facing AI applications falling short of high market expectations.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Platform Internet & Consumer Equities
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw renewed capital inflows following targeted domestic policy announcements aimed at stimulating service consumption and supporting digital platform innovation.
marketLayer.inference: Platform tech stocks are undergoing a valuation re-rating from depressed historical levels as earnings quality improves and capital return programs (buybacks/dividends) remain active.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Durability of broader macroeconomic consumption recovery and geopolitical tailwinds affecting cross-border capital flows.

marketLayer.title: Global EV & Clean Energy Supply Chains
marketLayer.fact: Leading electric vehicle manufacturers listed in HK and US markets reported rising overseas delivery figures, even as domestic price competition remains elevated.
marketLayer.inference: Industry profitability will increasingly diverge toward vertically integrated producers capable of offsetting domestic price pressure through higher-margin export expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential tariff adjustments and trade policy barriers in key export markets including Europe and North America.
